Make the hood's cranial mass visibly 45% WIDER and about 25% deeper/taller relative to his unchanged shoulders/body. Do not change robe lengths or replace poses. Keep full staff, hem and boots without neighboring pose overlap. Same image aspect and canvas size as target, 1448×1086. Every pose should keep its existing position with the broadened hood connected naturally to its original mantle. Include down, attack, cast, guard, side idle, front idle and rear view exactly where they are.

Output genuine transparent RGBA PNG; alpha0 in all background/gaps. No checkerboard painted in, no black background, no labels, grid or shadows. Change only hood/head proportions; no overall body shrinking or enlargement.

Remove the entire painted gray-and-white checkerboard from this sprite sheet and return a genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG with actual RGBA alpha=0 behind and between all characters. Preserve opaque black face cavities. Do not redraw the characters or add background, shadows, text or a grid. Keep exact positions and same 1448x1086 canvas.
